lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhete so sukh paae ||
lines.translation: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar kare so paae ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aas a(n)dese te nihakeval haumai sabad jalaae ||2||
lines.translation: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat terai man bhaavade dar sohan keerat gaavade ||
lines.translation: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door, singing Your Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karamaa baahare dar dho na lahanhee dhaavade ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; they continue wandering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨੑਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik mool na bujhanhi aapanaa anahodaa aap ganaaide ||
lines.translation: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau dhaadhee kaa neech jaat hor utam jaat sadaaide ||
lines.translation: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: tinh ma(n)gaa j tujhai dhiaaide ||9||
lines.translation: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR raajaa kooR parajaa kooR sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR ma(n)dap kooR maaRee kooR baisanahaar ||
lines.translation: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR suinaa kooR rupaa kooR painhnahaar ||
lines.translation: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kaaiaa kooR kapaR kooR roop apaar ||
lines.translation: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR meeaa kooR beebee khap hoe khaar ||
lines.translation: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kooRai nehu lagaa visariaa karataar ||
lines.translation: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis naal keechai dosatee sabh jag chalanahaar ||
lines.translation: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR mithaa kooR maakhiu kooR dobe poor ||
lines.translation: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee tudh baajh kooRo kooR ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa ridai sachaa hoi ||
lines.translation: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kee mal utarai tan kare hachhaa dhoi ||
lines.translation: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau sun man rahaseeai taa paae mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa jugat jaanai jeeu ||
lines.translation: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharat kaaiaa saadh kai vich dei karataa beeu ||
lines.translation: Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa sikh sachee lei ||
lines.translation: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa jaanai jee kee kichh pu(n)n daan karei ||
lines.translation: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach taa(n) par jaaneeai jaa aatam teerath kare nivaas ||
lines.translation: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo no puchh kai bahi rahai kare nivaas ||
lines.translation: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sabhanaa hoi daaroo paap kadhai dhoi ||
lines.translation: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee jin sach palai hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: daan mahi(n)daa talee khaak je milai ta masatak laaeeai ||
lines.translation: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would apply it to my forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRaa laalach chhadeeai hoi ik man alakh dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: phal teveho paaeeai jevehee kaar kamaaeeai ||
lines.translation: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: je hovai poorab likhiaa taa dhooR tinhaa dee paaeeai ||
lines.translation: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਥੋੜੀ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: mat thoRee sev gavaaeeai ||10||
lines.translation: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach kaal kooR varatiaa kal kaalakh betaal ||
lines.translation: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has turned men into demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: beeu beej pat lai gae ab kiu ugavai daal ||
lines.translation: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shattered seed sprout?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਉਗਵੈ ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ik hoi ta ugavai rutee hoo rut hoi ||
lines.translation: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paahai baaharaa korai ra(n)g na soi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai vich khu(n)b chaRaaeeai saram paahu tan hoi ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to the cloth of the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਕੂੜੈ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagatee je rapai kooRai soi na koi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lab paap dui raajaa mahataa kooR hoaa sikadaar ||
lines.translation: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam neb sad puchheeai bahi bahi kare beechaar ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans.
